findings.message: Scope in requires phase3-continue-02 to cite '19.L, 19.I, 19.P3 and the entry units of its next payload'. Its next payload is admissions[2] = [rework-stage]. CHUPA_PLAN.md has P3 entry units only for daemon-scheduler (line 1800), merge-queue (line 1807) and seed-successor-proof (line 1824); there is no `### 19.P3.rework-stage`. A `## Plan contract` bullet citing 19.P3.rework-stage fails intake lint, because `resolve_plan_contract` is called on every cite in chupa/tickets.py validate_ticket. The ticket's own premise check would also stop on the missing unit. The plan is missing rework-stage's Owner (chupa/rework.py, specs/rework.md), Records (the ConflictHandoff it consumes, the supersedes-map shape and its writer, the update/split/escalate outputs), Observable (dormancy) and Tests (named obligations). The seed path needs these facts and must not invent them.
findings.paved_road: Before this seeding ticket runs, harden the plan through section 11.4: a harden-rework-stage-1 ticket adds `### 19.P3.rework-stage` with Owner, Records, Observable and Tests bullets taken from the registry row and the merge-queue ConflictHandoff contract. Then rerun phase3-continue unchanged. Alternatively, re-author phase3-continue to depend on that hardening ticket so the successor's required cite resolves when it is authored.
